identity.title: Staff of Detective Pikachu – Birth of a New Duo

leadText: This is a list of staff members who worked on the game Detective Pikachu – Birth of a New Duo for the Nintendo 3DS, per the game's credits. It was published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company and developed by Creatures, Inc..
plainText:
